resources.string: F Spy - Family Safety & Device Management

F Spy is designed for parental guidance and family safety. Your device will share location, battery status, and app usage with your designated family guardian. Screen sharing requires active approval per session.
Grant permission for your family administrator to view installed application names and version numbers to help protect against harmful apps. Private app data, passwords, or chats are never accessed.
